svg.title: How to read a dot density map
svg.desc: Eight counties in eastern North Carolina with one dot per 10,000 head of livestock, 2022 Census of Agriculture. Duplin County has 188 blue dots for 1,884,573 hogs and 2 orange dots for 21,940 cattle; Sampson County has 185 blue dots. Notes explain the four steps: read the dot value, count the dots, compare how tightly they are packed, and remember that each dot is placed at random inside its county, so it does not mark a farm.
svg.text: Hogs and cattle in eight North Carolina counties
1 dot = 10,000 head, placed at random inside each county (2022)
Duplin and Sampson are the densest.
Each dot is at a random place
Data: USDA NASS, 2022 Census of Agriculture. Outlines: US Census Bureau.
